headline: Stocks Surge: DGW Breaks Out on Expectations of New iPhone, VNT Escapes Warning and Rises 60%
summary: Stocks surged on the HoSE and HNX exchanges last week. DGW broke out on iPhone expectations and VNT rose after escaping a warning, while two new UPCoM listings debuted.
why: The VN-Index tracks the largest listed companies on Ho Chi Minh City's exchange, the main equity benchmark for Vietnam's market.
why_moved: Gains were concentrated in stocks such as DGW, which rose on expectations surrounding the iPhone, and VNT, which recovered after escaping a warning.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Cổ phiếu tăng mạnh: DGW bứt phá nhờ iPhone mới, thoát diện cảnh báo VNT tăng 60%
